# Acoustic Glider Analysis Tools and Environment

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/6.x/svgs/regular/calendar-check.svg" style="width:0.88em;height:1em"> *Last Update: `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %b %Y")`*

A collection of MATLAB-based tools for working with passive acoustic gliders, 
particularly for marine mammal surveys. Tools cover piloting passive acoustic 
gliders, processing glider positional and environmental data, and analyzing 
glider-collected passive acoustic data.

This package is under active development and version controlled on 
[GitHub](https://github.com/sfregosi/agate). Use a 
[stable release](https://github.com/sfregosi/agate/releases) for reliability, 
or clone the repository directly for the latest functionality.

**Documentation:** [sfregosi.github.io/agate](https://sfregosi.github.io/agate) 
*(under construction — feedback welcome!)*

**MATLAB compatibility:** developed and tested primarily on R2024b, with some 
testing back to R2020b.

**Test data:** a small Seaglider test dataset is available on 
[Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1YZqnzZEor6v1lGQPB4EQll3-U2lfSh8n){target="_blank"}
— request access via the link or by emailing me.

## Contributing

Contributions from the passive acoustic glider community are welcome! See 
[CONTRIBUTING.md](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to report bugs, request 
features, or submit a pull request. Questions and feedback are always welcome 
too — just reach out.

## Citation

If you use `agate` in your work, please cite it. See [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff), 
or use the "Cite this repository" button on GitHub.
